summary: Frontend-only verification of one-tap Copy button feature across Swagger UI (/api/docs), blog posts, and /documentation regression. All acceptance criteria pass.

issues: Swagger .renderedMarkdown pre and blog-code-block have computed padding-right: 0px. The copy pill is absolutely positioned in a wrapper (button does not overflow the code box), but long code lines can visually run under the button because the pre itself has no right padding reserved. Spec asked for 'right padding so code does not run under the button'. Minor cosmetic — no functional impact.

action_items: Optional polish: add padding-right (~72px) to '.swagger-ui .renderedMarkdown pre' and to blog-code-block pre on mobile so long code lines don't visually pass under the Copy pill.
critical_code_review_comments: Swagger native example copy control ('.highlight-code .copy-to-clipboard') was NOT found on the tested POST op's example panel (count=0). The requirement mentioned it should still exist. Verified injection correctly skips .highlight-code (0 injected there), so the skip logic is safe; but if the native control is genuinely missing across the Swagger build, users lose copy on example panels. Worth confirming this was already the state prior to the feature.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Swagger op ids contain emoji (📡). Use page.locator('[id="operations-📡_Webhooks-get_api_webhooks"]'). Injected copy pill is an anchor button with data-testid=swagger-copy-btn inside a sibling div.dp-copy-wrap (not inside <pre>). Grant clipboard-read/write to https://cred-manager-29.preview.emergentagent.com origin. curl -sL localhost:8001/api/docs/ | grep -c dp-copy-btn == 4 confirms script served.

verified.swagger_integration_guide: 6 pres / 6 buttons; total 13 after both ops expanded; collapse+re-expand of first op still yields 7 (no duplicate stacking).
verified.swagger_highlight_code: 0 swagger-copy-btn injected inside .highlight-code (native area correctly skipped).
verified.swagger_mobile_390: 7 pres / 7 buttons; no button horizontally overflows the pre box. NOTE: pre padding-right computed 0px (see design_issues).
verified.blog_post_1: how-to-accept-crypto-payments-on-your-website: 2 blog-code-block / 2 code-copy-btn; first click -> label 'Copied', data-copied=true, clipboard starts with expected "const response = await fetch('https://dynopay.com/api/user/createPayment'"; reverts to 'Copy' after 1.5s.
